comments.author: Almeida
comments.body: If it's not clear to all, this is a Shipwright Town's man recipe only (at the ports listed) - no book available.

comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body: Because Jute is sold in Goa and Calcutta/Kolkata, this recipe is a nice add-on to any sewing/textile trade grinding you might be doing in that area, too.
